narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>To find an average, add all the values and divide by how many there are.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>The average does not have to be one of the counts, though here five does appear twice.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Check the count before you divide, because every attempt counts once, even a short one.
